note: Concept cards for the concepts added with Tử Vi Hàm Số (tools/build_ham_so_pack.py, engine/data/kg/concepts.json): traits, vocations and family readings that book names and the earlier books did not. Same conventions as concepts_identity.json (pred after 'thường', turn after 'dễ', soft when weakened, mature after 'khi biết', value after 'điều đáng quý là'). Each card voices only its concept and is used only when a fired, linked rule asserted it. Drafted by Claude 2026-10-24, review pending.
